$comment: The one set of directory-browsing response fixtures (#7). Both toolchains read this file: agent/internal/httpapi/directory_fixtures_test.go and packages/schema/src/directory-fixtures.test.ts. Never copy it per language. listings are DirectoryListing answers, errors are DirectoryError answers; each side checks them against the authoritative JSON Schema and against what it was generated into.

valid.name: a-project-directory
valid.why: Every entry kind the endpoint reports, a link inside and a link outside, an unreadable directory and an entry that could not be described, with the evidence that makes it look like a project.

valid.name: the-top-of-home
valid.why: No parent, because the directory above home is not browsable, and nothing in it. An empty directory still has an entries array and an evidence array.

valid.name: a-truncated-page
valid.why: A page holding exactly its limit, with the truncation marked.

invalid.name: no-truncated-flag
invalid.why: Whether the page is all of the directory is never left for a client to guess.

invalid.name: no-evidence
invalid.why: The evidence is always there, empty when there is none.

invalid.name: an-entry-kind-that-does-not-exist
invalid.why: A client branches on the kind, so it is one of the five.

invalid.name: an-entry-with-no-unreadable-flag
invalid.why: Readability is stated for every entry, not only for the unreadable ones.

invalid.name: a-link-target-that-does-not-exist
invalid.why: What a link leads to is one of the six answers.

invalid.name: a-resolved-path-on-the-side
invalid.why: The listing carries nothing beyond its own fields, so nothing describing the filesystem can ride along.

invalid.name: an-empty-parent
invalid.why: A directory with no browsable parent leaves parent out rather than sending an empty string.

valid.name: forbidden
valid.why: A path outside the browsable directories: a kind and a fixed sentence, nothing else.

body.message: only the authorized project directories and the home directory can be browsed

valid.name: not-found
valid.why: A path inside them that does not exist.

valid.name: unreadable
valid.why: A path inside them the agent may not read.

body.message: the agent is not permitted to read this directory

invalid.name: a-kind-that-does-not-exist
invalid.why: A client branches on the kind.

invalid.name: no-message
invalid.why: Every error has a sentence for a person.

invalid.name: a-resolved-path-on-the-side
invalid.why: A refusal carries no resolved path, root or cause, which is what keeps it from describing what is outside.

body.message: only the authorized project directories and the home directory can be browsed
